# GIE Founder Accuses Hawazen Foreign Minister of Spreading Unproven Claims

The founder of the **Greater Israeli Empire (GIE)** says Hawazen's Foreign Minister contacted them after apparently mistaking them for the leader of the **TPE**.

According to the GIE founder, the Foreign Minister said the GIE had **"disrespected the Quran"** and that Hawazen would **"never make peace with them."** The founder says that when asked for evidence, the Foreign Minister said they had none, and later said they had **"heard it from other factions"** without naming any.

The GIE founder says the conversation lasted about 10 minutes before they revealed they were the GIE's leader, not the TPE's. They also say Hawazen has been contacting factions it has been at war with about the GIE.

The GIE founder alleges that **AOCTL**, which they say was refused an alliance with Hawazen yesterday over "disrespecting the Quran", helped spread the claims. The founder has not shared evidence of AOCTL's involvement.

The founder also pointed to AOCTL's leader's statement at the UN summit that earlier claims about the GIE "using and manipulating" AOCTL were false. That clip is in #breaking-news.

**BCBN hasn't independently verified the conversation or any of these claims.** BCBN has asked Hawazen and AOCTL to respond.

We'll update this story as it develops.

# Black Cats Central Shuts Down as Owner Quits

**Black Cats Central (BCC)** is effectively shutting down after its **owner quit the faction entirely**, according to an everyone announcement in the BCC server.

The announcement says the owner will **no longer run BCC** and has asked members to join a different faction, **5V Allied Powers**. Members can stay in the BCC server for now, unless the owner decides to delete it.

According to the announcement, the split happened after **two BCC members set up their own faction without telling the owner**. The poster said they respected the new faction but called not telling the owner "extremely rude."

The announcement thanked members for their loyalty on behalf of the owner and three other BCC officials, and described 5V Allied Powers as "the next faction to take over the game."

**BCBN hasn't independently verified the reasons for the split.**   


We'll update this story as it develops.

**The UN is set to be disbanded**, according to an everyone announcement.

The announcement gave no further reasons. It's not yet clear when the UN will close, or what happens to the agreements and diplomacy that went through it.

**BCBN hasn't independently verified why the order was given.** We've reached out for more details.

We'll update this story as it develops.
